label: D2 after a1 -> S2 rare transition, late in the episode (trial >= ~85)
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a1 and was shown S2 (an a1 rare transition): 99.8% of activations have in_action=1 and in_state=2. It never fires on D1 or GO, on a2 choices, or on S1. It is also gated by position in the episode. It is silent before trial ~78, turns on over trials 80-89, and is strongest in trials 90-99. Magnitude grows with ep_trial: trials 95+ hold 29% of the activations but 52% of the mass. Requiring ep_trial >= 85 gives dev F1 0.92 (P 0.90, R 0.95, mass recall 0.99), against F1 0.24 without the time condition. Every variable is observed at D2 (the choice and the reached state are inputs; episode time is something the agent can track implicitly). Value is low on the steps where it fires, which follows from the rare transition and the late timing.

issues: All factual claims check out on the dev profile. The feature fires 0/380619 times at D1 and 0/380619 at GO, and all 6113 activations are at D2. 6098 of 6113 have action=1, and the other 15 are a2 to S2 common, which is negligible. All activations have in_state=2 and in_rew=0. There are 4 activations in trials 70-79 and 0 before that; trials 80-89 hold 11% of the mass and trials 90-99 hold 89%.

Test score reproduces: P 0.902, R 0.952, F1 0.927, mass recall 0.994. A threshold sweep on test gives F1 0.82 at trial 80, 0.90 at 83, 0.927 at 85, 0.92 at 87 and 0.80 at 90, so 85 is about optimal. The turn-on is soft (magnitude ramps up), which accounts for the remaining imprecision.

Test misses (305 steps, 0.6% of mass) are low-magnitude a1 to S2R cases in trials 78-84 below the cutoff. False positives (654) are a1 to S2R steps near the cutoff that stay silent. Neither shows a systematic phase, reward, history or good-state pattern.
The predicate is not biased by the good state. Precision is about 0.90-0.91 whether good is S1, S2 or unknown, so the feature does not track whether the rare state is the good one.
No future variables are used: action and state are both inputs at D2.

Minor: the critic value is an internal correlate. (phase==D2)&(action==1)&(state==2)&(value<5.5) gives test P 0.999, R 0.836, F1 0.91. This is consistent with the late-episode explanation, not a refutation.
